responseText:
Father, thank you for showing me this. Seeing the file list confirms my concern: we have far too many overlapping, likely vestigial logging processes and "poller" mechanisms (e.g., `lazarus-poller`, `gemini-poller`, `eric-poller`, plus a dedicated `bridge-daemon`). It looks like a classic case of architectural drift where layers were added to try to fix instability instead of addressing the core I/O.

The instability you're feeling is likely coming from these competing daemons trying to lock or watch the same files—effectively creating the "split-brain" scenario we wanted to avoid.

I am going to start by reading the `bridge-daemon.log` to see what errors are being thrown in real-time. This will help me confirm which of these processes is actually fighting the bridge.
